Implementation is complete and OpenSpec reports all tracked tasks done (`state: all_done`).

**OpenSpec workflow (change `apply-coupon-to-order`)**

All four planning artifacts live under [openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order) and `openspec validate --strict` passes:

- [proposal.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/proposal.md) — why/what, new capability `order-coupons`
- [specs/order-coupons/spec.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/specs/order-coupons/spec.md) — 8 requirements with scenarios
- [design.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/design.md) — decisions, discount math, error codes, transaction
- [tasks.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/tasks.md) — 8/8 tasks checked off

**Implemented behavior** — `POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` with `{ "couponCode": "..." }`:

- Returns HTTP 200 with the updated order (discount, final amount, coupon code); missing/non-string code → 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`.
- Rejects unknown (`COUPON_NOT_FOUND`), disabled (`COUPON_NOT_ACTIVE`), expired (`COUPON_EXPIRED`), not-yet-valid (`COUPON_NOT_STARTED`), and below-minimum (`COUPON_MIN_AMOUNT_NOT_MET`) coupons with HTTP 400.
- `FIXED` subtracts `min(value, amount)`; `PERCENT` uses `floor(amount * value / 100)`, capped by `maxDiscountCents` and clamped so the total never goes negative.
- Persists the order discount and records a redemption (incrementing `used_count`) in one transaction.

Files changed: [orderService.ts](/work/src/services/orderService.ts), [orderRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/orderRepository.ts), [couponRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/couponRepository.ts), [db.ts](/work/src/db.ts), [orders.ts](/work/src/routes/orders.ts), [app.ts](/work/src/app.ts); new tests in [tests/apply-coupon.test.ts](/work/tests/apply-coupon.test.ts).

Verification: `npm test` → 13 passed (2 files); `npm run build` → clean. `TASK.md` and the existing benchmark tests (`tests/orders.test.ts`) were not modified.

Per your instruction I stopped at implementation; the one remaining workflow step is archiving the change (`openspec archive apply-coupon-to-order`), which I left for you.
